notes.title: January 2025 Update
notes.content:
Hello, players!
This update brings a few quality-of-life features and improvements based on your feedback.

[h2]Compact Layout[/h2]
You can now switch to a compact layout. Perfect if you don't want to be distracted by the animated UI.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/ee3a082abdbc966eee7234dc99352425db3cc576.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/55ec1fa38912916241c93d56052a9ffd717da45b.png[/img][/url]

The option is available in the settings.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/f0b0b3d471a6c19dd59556ee9bdf082edef00747.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/7123194eebd0c8a7b40e8c6ae02703084d906313.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/7ee8be8e544a09ae7463aa45431401a8f07b2100.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/2813441c2341bc5545cda74b18b7a31608af41c6.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Enhanced Touch Controls[/h2]
On Steam Deck and touch screen computers, you can now place tents with a single tap. 
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/29b0dbeefbcafe2938c04740655b19d82e083d7c.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/fc5414e5d93464a9d28c0cd7dbcb2b73f6b80cfb.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/68407adbe120517c2b2adac48477f927ae6152c1.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/1c3befa855b49fb50a18058dbf182f95f0559f46.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Better Hint Contrast[/h2]
The contrast of certain hints has been improved to make them more readable, especially on larger grids.



[i][b]Found a bug? Have thoughts on the changes? Share them in the forums![/b][/i]

[b]Happy camping![/b]

notes.title: Layout update
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]

[i][b]Customize the layout of your grid to match your preferences with this new update![/b][/i]

[h3]Grid Placement Options[/h3]
Move the grid to either the left or right side of the screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/a5b0176f46a210e25be32207123da8dc898b3494.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/ce41c1a52d52576700c647c92f4bd4b9f0dc5512.png[/img]

[h3]Numbers Placement Options[/h3]
Choose whether to display the numbers on the left or right side of the grid.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/1588a29aa9dcbebdc106f4376cf20d6607f53d4d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/9a3f2086aed9b067917865f288ee5053abad117e.png[/img]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the pause menu could not be closed if the steam overlay is opened in another game
[*] Fix a bug where you could place invalid tent-tree links
[*] Fixed incorrectly unlocking daily hard pack
[/list]

[i][b]Have fun![/b][/i]

notes.title: Large Grids Update Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Here's a major update to Tents and Trees, I hope you'll like it!

[h3]480 New Levels[/h3]
24 packs ranging from 13x13 to 20x20 grids
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/b1bc0c6220efd8ba41fa9cc25f3cf0d41a776420.png[/img]
[h3]New Theme[/h3]
Relax with this coastal-inspired theme
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/66912a8ddf8aa9942ef05bbf3ef7c827da15bcad.png[/img]
[h3]11 New Achievements[/h3]
All related to the new large grids.

[h3]Other changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added tabbed UI in the level selection screen
[*] Star indicator when completing a pack without hints used.
[*] Tweaks to unlock conditions.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/8c4927023e6a3e5c649c44bd5564b7e955a6bdb3.png[/img]

[h3]Thanks for playing and enjoy the update![/h3]

notes.title: Update 1.2 - Steamdeck Update
notes.content:
While Tents and Trees is already "[i]Steamdeck Verified[/i]", this update adds better support for the Steamdeck.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/395875b2a009b434e264ce03de96b25c9b260556.png[/img]
[h3]It especially adds a feature you requested: [b]Touchscreen support![/b][/h3]
Touch screen works in the menus and in game.
[list]
[*] Tap once on the grid to place a tent.
[*] Tap twice to place grass.
[*] If you tap on a the number in a row/column that has all its tents, it automatically fills the remaining cells with grass.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fix colors of numbers around the grid not always updating after fast undoes
[*] Fix Steamdeck rendering quality when playing on other devices as well
[*] Disable rendering options when running on Steamdeck
[*] Fix bug with daily packs leaderboards (will take a few days to update the current scores)
[/list] 

If you find bugs or have suggestions, please post them in the forums!

Happy camping !

notes.title: Update 1.1.1
notes.content: Fix achievements count displayed on the main menu in-game.

notes.title: Update 1.1 - May 2024
notes.content:
Here is the first big update since the release last month.
Thanks for the feedback, and please continue to share your remarks, issues and ideas!

[h2]Themes[/h2]
[list]
[*]The [i]Tents and Trees (night)[/i] theme is [b]now available immediately[/b], no unlocking required.
[*]When reaching 200 levels, you [b]unlock[/b] two [i]Minimalist[/i] themes: day and night.
[/list]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/b8c37974e1c9cedb451f58facdb9f93742063c7d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/3065fc04a1f2d405ce61fbdb61caeb9a831eb7a2.png[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/7f20ddd5862f5d912fadac410579949a2ddfa95b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/d713771273a0d2675631356c416f6469095615b8.png[/img][/url]

[h2]Advanced Controls[/h2]
Added [i]Advanced Controls[/i] options in the settings:
[list]
[*]Added an option to [b]show icons when placing tents next to each other[/b] (can be disabled, ON by default). Changed the hint displayed when the grid was wrong because of tents next to each other.
[*]Added an option to update numbers around the grid to [b]show the remaining tents[/b] while playing (can be disabled, OFF by default)
[*]Added an option to [b]automatically fill grass[/b] at the end of level. Previously enabled by default, you can now disable it.
[/list]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/befe51be2787a4ca7f170c6ca9b932519799e11a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/ace72a516a6f0e8b046f807b0eeb409fcec1f20c.png[/img][/url]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/ddfac472d58667537de344a7b31456912cf44efe.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/a634af061934db66545f159b2e5d2ca8fbb96baf.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Last improvements before release
notes.content:
Here is a last patch before the release next week, coming from feedback of recent beta tests.
[list]
[*] Added keyboard support for undo and redo. You can undo a move with "Ctrl+Z" and redo with either "Ctrl+Shift+Z" or "Ctrl+Y"
[*] Added support of "fullscreen window" (also known as "borderless fullscreen"). This mode is better than standard fullscreen if you are using multiple monitors, or multi-tasking a lot. Available from the settings menu.
[*] Switching from windowed to fullscreen can now be done using F11 (as well as Alt+Enter).
[/list]

These changes are available on both the full game and the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44212013/253f7684d0787f249d8bb5f44423ef7f5a0ff67b.png[/img]

notes.title: This chill picross logic game about very prescriptive camping was a hit on Switch, and now it's coming to PC
notes.content:
I remember revealing at some point that my most-played game is actually a free-to-play picross game (picross, also called nonograms sometimes, being the logic puzzle game where you colour in squares on a grid to reveal a larger picture). You can imagine my intrigue when I saw that Tents And Trees, a picross-ish puzzle game previously on Switch and phones, is coming to PC on April 24th. That's a couple of months away, but you can play the short demo on Steam now to get a taste. It's slick and clean, and I like it!

Read more
